type: Electronic control box for lockstitch / overlock sewing machines
source: ZB-F6电控使用说明书V1.0英文-2025-7-9.pdf (F6 Control Box Manual Book, 9 pages, English)
note: The ZB-F6 (F6) control box is a simple 2-button LED controller. Per J8 monitoring model code: 1/4/FF=F5, 2=20U, 3=8558G/8560G — meaning this controller firmware covers F5, 20U, 8558G and 8560G machine variants. See also ZB-F4.json for the similar earlier controller.

panel.display: First digit shows 'P' in standby (needle stop position in second digit). Shows 'oK' on save/success. Shows error codes (E1, E2...). Speed shown as N×100rpm.

buttons.name: + (Up/Speed+)
functions: In F interface: navigate to next parameter number
Long press + in standby: enter needle stop position setting
Long press both + and - for 3s: enter parameter F interface
Press + when error shown: attempt error recovery / re-detect

buttons.name: - (Down/Speed-)
functions: In F interface: show current parameter value / change value
Long press - for 3s in standby: restore factory settings (shows 'oK')
Long press both + and - for 3s: enter parameter F interface
When E5 shown: long press to close needle stop function
When E7 shown: long press to close safety switch function

parameterEntry.speedAdjust: Short press + or - in standby to adjust speed ±100RPM per press. Hold for continuous change. Auto-saved after 3 seconds.
parameterEntry.needleStopPosition: Long press + in standby to enter needle stop position setting. Saved automatically.
parameterEntry.enterFInterface: Long press both + and - simultaneously for about 3s in standby to enter F parameter interface (first digit shows 'F').
parameterEntry.navigateF: In F interface: press + to change parameter number; press - to show/modify value; press + to save (shows 'oK'); motor operation exits to standby.
parameterEntry.factoryReset: Long press - for 3s in standby. Digital tube shows 'oK' if successful.
parameterEntry.enterMonitoringJ: In F interface: long press - for 3s to enter J monitoring interface (first digit shows 'J'). In J interface: press + to change parameter number; press - to show value. In J5: press - again to show historical fault code. In J9: press - to adjust pedal standby range. Press + to save. Short press back-button to return. Short press - in J interface to return to P interface.

parameters.name: Max sewing speed
parameters.description: Displayed value × 100 = actual RPM. Increase/decrease by 500rpm per step.

parameters.name: Point stitch
parameters.description: Larger value = larger point stitch interval

parameters.name: Speed controller model selection
parameters.description: 0=Computerized type (flat sewing computer model); 1=ZB simple type. After changing, power off and replace governor. If error on next power-on, check speed controller model match.

monitoring.description: Pedal voltage monitoring. Displayed value ÷ 10 = actual pedal voltage (V). Shown in both standby and running states.
Speed. Displayed value × 100 = actual speed (RPM). Shown in both standby and running states.
Power. Displayed value × 10 = actual power (W). Shown in both standby and running states.
Input voltage. Displayed value × 10 = actual voltage (V). Shown in standby mode.
Historical maximum voltage. Displayed value × 10 = actual highest input voltage recorded (V).
Historical error code. Shows latest 5 error codes. Press - again in J5 to switch to historical fault display. Displays '00' when no error history. Auto-returns to standby after 8s without input.
Cumulative running time of control box. Displayed value × 100 = actual time (hours).
Model code. 1/4/FF=F5; 2=20U; 3=8558G/8560G. Note: some firmware versions do not have J8 monitoring.

Speed controller standby range adjustment. Shows middle voltage under current pedal standby state. Displayed value ÷ 10 = actual voltage. Press - to modify; press + to save ('oK'). Changing this adjusts the speed controller standby range.
Fix version number of the electronic control software.

errorCodes.description: Sleep mode (standby about 30 minutes) or supply voltage too low
errorCodes.solution: Press + or - to wake machine. If alarm remains, check if power supply voltage is normal.
1. Turn hand wheel — check if machine head is stuck or dry/difficult to rotate. 2. Check motor plug-in is not loose or fallen off. 3. Check if material is too thick (insufficient torque).
1. Turn off and power on again. 2. If alarm persists: check if motor load is too large, sewing material is too thick, or machine lacks lubrication. 3. Contact maintenance personnel if unresolved.
Check if motor encoder plug connection is reliable, if encoder signal wire is broken, and if pin exits or deforms.

Turn handwheel. If alarm cannot be eliminated, power off and on again. Check encoder/positioner plug connection reliability. Abnormal Hall of motor positioner. Long press - for 3s when E5 shown to close needle stop function.

If E6 is flashing: check if speed controller type matches parameter b (default=computerized type). Adjust b parameter accordingly. If E6 is always on: check if speed controller is inserted and plug/pin is not loose or fallen off. Replace governor if alarm persists.

errorCodes.description: Head safety switch alarm (machine head dump)
errorCodes.solution: Restore head position to normal, ensure safety switch is reset. Long press - to close safety switch alarm function if needed. Contact maintenance if alarm persists.
Turn off power and power on again. Contact maintenance personnel if alarm cannot be eliminated.
Turn off power supply immediately. Check if voltage exceeds 294V (220V box) or 147V (110V box). Adjust to rated voltage before restarting.
Cut off power supply immediately. Check if voltage is below 110V (220V box) or 55V (110V box). Adjust to rated voltage before restarting.
Check if circuit board is clean. Check if power supply voltage is normal. Try turning power off and on again (check power board functions carefully).

errorCodes.description: Complementary stitch button failure (button of machine head stuck in off position)
errorCodes.solution: Check if complementary stitch button of machine head can be turned on and off normally. If stuck in off position, replace machine head button. Note: alarm automatically turns off complementary stitch function but does not affect motor operation. Alarm clears automatically after 30s or press + to clear.

troubleshooting.cause: Speed controller type does not match parameter b setting
troubleshooting.solution: Check parameter b value (0=computerized type, 1=ZB simple type) and adjust to match the installed speed controller.

troubleshooting.cause: Speed controller not plugged in or plug/pin loose
troubleshooting.solution: Check speed controller connection. Replace governor if alarm persists. Contact maintenance if still present.
Press + to re-detect whether error exists. If cleared, error alarm releases. If not, alarm continues. For E5 or E7: long press - to disable needle stop or safety switch function.
